facility.name: Horn's Academy Child Care Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 1511 BOSQUE BLVD, WACO, TX, 76707

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Out of 8 children's files, there was 1 child that did not have a health statement on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One out of 8 children's files reviewed did not have an immunization record on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation's last documented fire drill was completed in June 2025. A fire drill was completed during the inspection to bring the deficiency into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers of Groups Not Combined Not Additional: All caregivers observed during naptime, were counted in ratio. There was not another person observed in the building when I arrived.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers of Groups Not Combined Not Additional (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Not Used as a Passageway: An infant classroom was observed to have been utilized as a passageway by the older children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Not Used as a Passageway (26 TAC §746.2403(6))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: An infant was observed in their classroom with children with more than an 18 month age gap. During the inspection, the infant was moved back to the younger infant classroom and an additional caregiver was placed in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: One caregiver was unaware of the ages of the children in her group. Another caregiver was unaware of the age of the youngest child in care and the caregiver did not have documentation of the child's age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver was unaware of the number of children in her group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: A child was observed sitting in a small highchair and was observed to not have been fastened with their seatbelt.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: An infant was observed to not have been fastened while they were in a bouncer. The caregiver fastened the infant during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: A group of children were observed eating snacks out of there hands, while they were sitting on the floor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: It was determined the operation did not follow the instructions on an infant's feeding instructions, when they gave an infant a different type of formula.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined a caregiver and a parent had an argument in the presence of children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers Physically Present: One caregiver was observed in the doorway during nap time, supervising two classrooms.  Compliance was met during the inspection when two caregivers returned from their lunch breaks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers Physically Present (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employees Required: During the current inspection, there were 2 caregivers counted in ratio during nap time and there was not another caregiver present in the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employees Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - No Foods That Present Choking Risk: An infant and toddlers were observed eating Doritos for a snack.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - No Foods That Present Choking Risk (26 TAC §746.3317(7))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A 15 month old infant was observed in a classroom with children who were 3, 4 and 5 years olds.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - Basis: A 15 month infant was observed in a Toddler Classroom that was not regulated for Infants.   The infant was placed back in their classroom during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - Basis (26 TAC §746.1507(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: A caregiver in a classroom was unaware of the ages of children in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: There was 1 caregiver observed in a classroom prior to having pre-service training on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: 746.1301(a)(1)A - Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: There was 1 caregiver observed in a classroom that did not have orientation on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: 746.1301(a)(1)A - Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)A - Training Requirements )

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: During an investigation, it was determined a caregiver hit a child in care on the arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: A 12 month old infant was observed sleeping in his crib with a bottle.  This was corrected when the Director instructed the caregiver to remove the bottle from the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers Physically Present: There were 3 caregivers present upon arrival, each caregiver was observed supervising a group of children during naptime. There was not another caregiver present in the building  to answer the door to parents without a caregiver having to leave the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers Physically Present (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: There were 2 infants that did not have updated infant feeding instructions. The feeding instructions were last updated on 10/3/22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - Basis: A 15 month infant was observed in a Toddler Classroom that was not regulated for Infants. Ms. Rembert removed the infant from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - Basis (26 TAC §746.1507(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Observed two caregivers not knowing how many children they had in their care. One caregiver stated they had 12 children and they only had 11. The other caregiver stated they had 9 children but had 8 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: It was determined through the investigation only 2 classrooms have window air condition units, the remaining classrooms were observed to have been warm and not properly ventilated. During an inspection the temperature at the operation was observed to be 86 degrees.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §746.3407(10))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not use good judgment when she attempted to remove a child from a infant chair and did not move an infant in close proximity on the floor to the chair, causing the chair to hit the infant on the floor, when the chair was lifted on the ground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: It was determined through an investigation that a caregiver was neglectful in the supervision of a child in care, which resulted in the child to receive an injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregiver: A caregiver failed to pass on information to a child's primary caregiver when she returned from lunch, that a child in care had received an injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregiver (26 TAC §746.1203(11))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: A caregiver did not utilize the straps in an infant chair which caused a child to fall out of the chair and receive an injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It  was determined through information obtained through the investigation, a caregiver did not utilize good judgment when they transported an infant in an infant seat outside, rather than carrying the infant outside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: It was determined through the investigation, parents are not informed of less serious injuries their child receives while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: It was determined through an investigation the operation did not report an injury, a child sustained while in care, that required medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization: It was determined the operation did not notify the parent immediately of an injury the child received while in care. The parent was not notified until approximately an hour after the injury occurred.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.307(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: It was determined based on evidence gathered during the investigation, the operation is not properly labeling bottle and pacifiers for infants in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: It was determined, through an investigation, a caregiver neglected to properly supervise a child in care, which caused the child to receive an injury; due to a fall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - Basis: Two 11 month old infants were observed grouped with 2 year children in a classroom that is not regulated for infants.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - Basis (26 TAC §746.1507(1))
